title: Translation queue (run artifact: l10n/queue/queue.json — never committed)
description: Ordered set of LLM jobs for one run. Resumption is derived from this file alone. See .claude/rules/l10n-pipeline-spec.md §4.

schema.description: Format discriminator; bump on breaking change.

run_id.description: UTC compact timestamp + 6 random hex chars, e.g. 20260804T120000Z-3f9c21.

source_commit.description: Git commit of md/ the plan was computed from.

id.description: "<lang>:<unit_hash>" — unique within a queue (jobs are deduplicated by (lang, unit_hash) across documents).

unit_hash.description: tree_diff.hash_tree hash of the unit's canonical source — the TM key this job's result is written under.

action.description: Only the two API-calling tree_diff actions become jobs (spec §2).

context.description: Heading-trail context from tree_diff — read-only context for the prompt; empty string when the unit precedes any heading.

placeholders.description: Inline spans that must survive translation verbatim; validated by the placeholder gate (spec §5).

old_source.description: REVISE only: the previous source text. null for TRANSLATE.

prior_translation.description: REVISE only: the existing translation being revised. null for TRANSLATE.

state.description: Terminal: done, rejected. Legal transitions in spec §4 — pending→in_flight, pending→done (TM shortcut), in_flight→done|failed, failed→in_flight|rejected, restart rewrites in_flight→pending.

attempts.description: Completed attempts so far (incremented on in_flight→failed).

max_attempts.description: attempts == max_attempts on a failed job forces failed→rejected.

error.description: Last failure, kept until the job succeeds or is rejected. null when never failed or after success.

started_at.description: First pending→in_flight transition. null while pending.

finished_at.description: Transition into a terminal state. null while non-terminal.

kind.description: rate_limit = HTTP 429; network = transient connectivity; api_error = any other provider error; placeholder_lost = failed the placeholder gate (spec §5).

detail.description: Human-readable detail; for placeholder_lost, names the lost placeholder(s) and their source/translation occurrence counts.
